title: 第155章 开始制衣第156章 庭院闲谈
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
玉尺郎应声而出。
他身形一晃，整个人在空中化作一柄修长莹润的白玉仙尺，凌空飘起。
尺身通体雪白，表面刻着细密的天庭度量符文。
仙尺灵动游走，绕着纪风周身上下翻飞。
纪风没想到刚来便已开始为他量身，制作仙衣，当下站起身配合。
他展开双臂，站得端端正正。
那仙尺贴着他的肩头轻轻一触，又滑向身后，再绕到腰侧。
肩宽、背厚、腰围、衣长、袖摆......
每一处尺寸都丈量的清清楚楚。
不过数息便已完成。
白玉仙尺落到地上，法光一闪，又化作那个清瘦少年。
他将量得的尺寸一一报给云织仙。
得到纪风的身量尺寸后，云织仙拿起那卷冰蚕雪丝，反复比对尺寸。
沉吟片刻后，云织仙抬头对纪风说道：
“纪公子，这卷冰蚕雪丝做完你的衣袍后，还余下不少料子。”
听闻布料还有剩余，纪风问道：
“余下的布料，能否再做出三套？”
他有了新衣，自然也不能忘了知白、牛渊和绾绾三个。
云织仙看向知白，又看向纪风肩头显露出身形的绾绾，最后看向站在纪风身后的牛渊，摇了摇头。
“剩余布料只够这位小童和你肩头的小人。”

“那位身形高大魁梧，怕是远远不够。”
牛渊站在纪风身后，听闻布料不够，并不气馁，对纪风说道：
“公子，俺无妨，穿这身挺好的。”
“仙子，闲庭内是否有......”
纪风刚要询问闲庭内是否有其他适合牛渊的布料，忽然想起一件事来。
“对了，仙子。”
“除了灵丝锦缎外，不知你能否用异兽麟甲制衣？”
“自然可以。”
云织仙点了点头：“只要材质合适，我都可以制作衣，但材质不同，制作的仙衣类型也不同。”
“那正好。”
纪风抬手伸向袖中芥子袋，灵光一闪，取出一大片完整的黑色鳞皮。
鳞皮一摊开，表面光泽厚重，鳞片层层堆叠如铁片，上边还隐隐萦绕着水行灵气。
正是当日在灵剑山万剑冢中斩杀的玄鳞蛟蛟皮。
content_en:
Yuchilang came out in response.
His body swayed, and his whole body turned into a slender and shiny white jade fairy ruler, floating in the air.
The body of the ruler is completely white, with fine heavenly measurement runes engraved on its surface.
The immortal ruler moved flexibly, flying around Ji Feng's body.
Ji Feng didn't expect that he would already start tailoring and making fairy clothes for him as soon as he arrived. He immediately stood up and cooperated.
He spread his arms and stood upright.
The fairy ruler touched his shoulder lightly, slid behind him, and then wrapped around his waist.
Shoulder width, back thickness, waist circumference, length, sleeve hem...
Every dimension is clearly measured.
But the number of interest is completed.
The white jade fairy ruler fell to the ground, and with a flash of magical light, it transformed into the thin young man again.
He reported the measurements one by one to Yun Zhixian.
After getting Ji Feng's body measurements, Yun Zhixian picked up the roll of ice silkworm snow silk and compared the sizes repeatedly.
After pondering for a moment, Yun Zhixian raised his head and said to Ji Feng:
"Mr. Ji, after this roll of ice silkworm and snow silk is used to make your robe, there is still a lot of material left."
Hearing that there was still some fabric left, Ji Feng asked:
"Can I make three more sets with the remaining fabric?"
He had new clothes, so naturally he couldn't forget Zhibai, Niu Yuan and Wanwan.
Yun Zhixian looked at Zhibai, then at Wanwan, whose figure was revealed on Ji Feng's shoulder, and finally at Niu Yuan, who was standing behind Ji Feng, and shook his head.
"There is only enough fabric left for this little boy and the little man on your shoulders."
"That one is tall and burly, I'm afraid it's not enough."
Niu Yuan stood behind Ji Feng. Hearing that there was not enough fabric, he was not discouraged and said to Ji Feng:
"Sir, it's fine with me. This dress looks good."
"Fairy, is there anyone in the courtyard..."
Just as Ji Feng was about to ask if there were other fabrics suitable for Niu Yuan in Xianting, he suddenly remembered something.
"That's right, fairy."
"In addition to the spiritual silk brocade, I wonder if you can use the armor of alien beasts to make clothes?"
"Of course you can."
Yun Zhixian nodded: "As long as the material is suitable, I can make clothes, but different materials will lead to different types of clothes."
"That's just right."
Ji Feng raised his hand and reached into the mustard bag in his sleeve. With a flash of inspiration, he took out a large piece of complete black scale skin.
Once the scales are spread out, the surface is shiny and thick. The scales are stacked layer by layer like iron sheets, and there is still a faint aura of water lingering on them.
It was the skin of the black-scaled dragon that was killed in the Tomb of Ten Thousand Swords in Lingjian Mountain that day.
